users_identity_required_check.name: users_identity_required_check
users_identity_required_check.value:
"users"."status" = 'anonymized' or (
        "users"."name" is not null
        and "users"."email" is not null
        and "users"."whatsapp" is not null
        and "users"."pseudonym_key" is not null
      )

users_anonymized_scrubbed_check.name: users_anonymized_scrubbed_check
users_anonymized_scrubbed_check.value:
"users"."status" <> 'anonymized' or (
        "users"."name" is null
        and "users"."email" is null
        and "users"."whatsapp" is null
        and "users"."password_hash" is null
        and "users"."avatar_url" is null
        and "users"."pseudonym_key" is null
        and "users"."anonymized_at" is not null
      )

diagnostic_responses_target_check.name: diagnostic_responses_target_check
diagnostic_responses_target_check.value: ("diagnostic_responses"."plan_subject_id" is not null) or ("diagnostic_responses"."plan_topic_id" is not null)

diagnostics_completed_is_locked_check.name: diagnostics_completed_is_locked_check
diagnostics_completed_is_locked_check.value: "diagnostics"."status" <> 'completed' or ("diagnostics"."completed_at" is not null and "diagnostics"."locked_at" is not null)
